climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Sonoma County AVA northeast of Santa Rosa around the historic community of Fountain Grove, covering 38,000 acres with about 500 under vine. Grown grapes include Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Zinfandel, Syrah and Viognier.
